claims.claim: A photographed release dated April7,2000 attributes a meeting and joint task-force organizing announcement to Forsyth Sheriff Denny Hendrix and Dawson Sheriff Billy Carlisle; it says investigative protocol was still to be formulated.
claims.assessment_rationale: Attribution to visually inspected third-party document photograph only; original issuance, participation and implementation unverified.
claims.notes: BATCH-RESEARCH-20261024-005; do not convert an announcement into proof of operational joint participation or resolve later disagreements.

claim_sources.source_locator: release-scan.jpg, printed April7,2000; headline and body paragraphs1–3
claim_sources.excerpt: As soon as the investigative protocol is formulated
claim_sources.notes: Reproduced issuer statement attributes agreement to both named sheriffs, not a personal interview with either. No signed original held.
